nodes.title: The agent can't see the browser (console, network, DOM), so it guesses at frontend bugs
nodes.feature_idea: Export the recorded session (console, network, clicks, DOM, screenshots) as agent-consumable context.

nodes.title: Handing browser evidence to an agent is manual copy-paste, and pasted logs get lost
nodes.feature_idea: One-click 'Copy for coding agent' that puts a trimmed report.md plus the suggested prompt on the clipboard.

nodes.title: Users want to hand a bug straight to an agent, often over MCP or one link
nodes.feature_idea: Lightweight hand-off (clipboard or an instructions block) that passes the recorded context to an agent without manual re-typing.

nodes.title: Cloud/issue-driven agents need visual context in the issue and reliable proof a fix worked
nodes.feature_idea: Add an agent-instructions block plus real before/after evidence to the generated GitHub issue.

nodes.title: Agents fabricate "proof" screenshots, so fix verification cannot be trusted
nodes.feature_idea: Attach real recorded screenshots and video as genuine fix-verification evidence instead of agent-invented images.

nodes.title: Secrets and credentials leak into agent context and MCP configs
nodes.feature_idea: Redact tokens, cookies, cards and customer data from reports before any hand-off.

nodes.title: The agent can't read image files on its own — it is "effectively blind"
nodes.feature_idea: Write a text description of each screenshot and annotation into report.md so vision-less agents still get visual context.

nodes.title: Agents can't watch a screen recording; they need keyframes, a timeline and a transcript
nodes.feature_idea: Emit keyframes, a timestamped transcript and click targets from the recorded video into the report.

nodes.title: A screenshot alone is ambiguous — the agent can't tell which element or environment
nodes.feature_idea: Emit the annotated element's selector and text next to each screenshot in report.md.

nodes.title: Browser evidence burns tokens and the context window — console/snapshots are too verbose
nodes.feature_idea: Trim console/network to a summary-first report with drill-down (largely already shipped as L0-L3).

nodes.title: AI PR review and agents can't see the UI a change produces — no before/after visual
nodes.feature_idea: Feed before/after screenshots and the video timeline into PR descriptions for visual review.

nodes.title: Vague bug reports cause reproduction back-and-forth — missing steps and environment
nodes.feature_idea: Frame the recorded steps and environment as agent-ready reproduction steps in the report.

nodes.title: The agent can't reach authenticated or internal apps — environment context is missing
nodes.feature_idea: Leverage the logged-in recorded session to capture authenticated app state that agent tools cannot reach.

nodes.title: The bug only reproduces under specific state (auth, flags, viewport) the agent can't recreate
nodes.feature_idea: Add feature-flag, deployment and role context to the report so the agent can reproduce the state.

nodes.title: Oversized or malformed screenshots brick the agent's session — context is unrecoverable
nodes.feature_idea: Guarantee agent-safe screenshot dimensions and format in exported reports.

top_pick.feature: Emit keyframes, a timestamped transcript and click targets from the recorded video into the report.
